execution: local CPU integer reference only; no new weights or remote jobs
balance: post-RoPE per-channel q*=2^g,k*=2^-g; g=clamp(RNE(0.5*log2(maxabs(K)/maxabs(Q))),-8,8); fitted on these captured blocks, not heldout quality
scale: offline maxabs power-of-two exponent i8; Q per row, K/V per token block and head
score: i16/f8; C1 M31/r0..63 compiled offline from Q*K scale / sqrt(128)
pv: P7/P15 times signed8 V; block partial i32; align dyadic scales in i64; signed RNE divide by 2^P-1; output i16/f12
oracle: independent Python Fraction, dot loops, round; zero integer mismatch required
quality: report stage errors, saturation and negative controls; no model-quality acceptance from one head
bias: synthetic Qwen2-style bias study, not observed Qwen3 bias; i32 acc + i32 row-dependent bias -> checked i33 before M31
